data.ruling:
The refutation stands on input withstand (V179). The accuracy half of the functional-match refutation does not stand on its own.

(1) Input withstand. The INA237's absolute maximum between IN+ and IN- is -40 to +40 V (SBOSA20A section 6.1). V179 is marked "for research" (owner, 2026-09-28), so the owner has set no number. The verifier's 85 V has no readable source: this function has no P2 record, and 85 V is not on the page as V179's answer. The refutation holds without that figure. V179's own fault cases already put more than 40 V between the leads, and they rest on F15, the owner's 67.2 V pack (16 cells x 4.2 V):
- "Load side shorted to ground" on a high-side shunt. SBOSA20A section 8.1.4 says such a short "can result in full power-supply voltage across the shunt", so up to 67.2 V appears between the leads.
- "A sense lead on the wrong terminal" on either side (V177 is also unanswered). One lead on the pack's positive and one near ground puts up to 67.2 V between them.
In both cases the voltage exceeds the 40 V rating by at least 27.2 V. So any value the research finds for V179 is at least 67.2 V, and the INA237 does not meet it on its own ratings. The INA238 it stands in for has the same -40 to +40 V rating (SLYS025B section 5.1), so this failure is the function's, not only the alternate's.

(2) Accuracy (CMRR, common-mode rejection ratio). The figures are correct:
- INA237: CMRR 120 dB minimum = 1 uV/V. Across 5 to 67.2 V that is 62.2 uV, or 0.62 A on 100 uOhm.
- INA238: CMRR 140 dB minimum = 0.1 uV/V, or 0.062 A.
- Shunt offset is also 10 times worse on the INA237: +/-50 uV maximum against +/-5 uV.
But the limit the verifier tested against, +/-0.15 A below 15 A, is not a requirement. V166 is "for research". No +/-0.15 A for the motor current appears in IOBoard.md or Research.md: the only 0.15 A there is the servo bind step (IOBoard.md:355, V174). No P2 record for this function could be read, because T3's P2-R8 return is not under results/. So this half has no requirement behind it.

(3) The verifier's "failed" list also names common mode, bus-voltage connection, Kelvin and filter, monitor and manufacturer allowlist. Those checks passed. They only disagree because this function has no shortlist record. Texas Instruments is on S1.

Observation outside the refutation, for the re-rank: the INA237 register map (SBOSA20A Table 7-3) ends at MANUFACTURER_ID 3Eh and has no DEVICE_ID register at 3Fh. The INA238 has DEVICE_ID at 3Fh, reset 2381h (SLYS025B Table 6-3), and the specification tells the footprint's parts apart by that register (IOBoard.md, Monitor footprint row). That bears on rule 5's "same firmware configuration (registers)".

Scope is function. The failure comes from this function's withstand requirement. It says nothing about the INA237's lifecycle, allowlist or LCSC identity. The stock verifier found those passing: ACTIVE, Digi-Key Active, C2864837 with 5344 in stock.
data.evidence:
- INA237 datasheet SBOSA20A (February 2021, revised May 2022):
  - Section 6.1: Differential (VIN+) - (VIN-) -40 to 40 V; common mode -0.3 to 85 V; 5 mA into any pin.
  - Section 8.1.4: "The device inputs are specified to tolerate +/-40 V differential across the IN+ and IN- pins. A large differential scenario might be a short to ground on the load side of the shunt. This type of event can result in full power-supply voltage across the shunt."
  - Section 6.5: CMRR 120 dB min, 140 dB typ; Vos +/-15 uV typ, +/-50 uV max; gain error +/-0.3 % max.
  - Table 7-3: registers 0h to 11h and 3Eh MANUFACTURER_ID; no 3Fh.
- INA238 datasheet SLYS025B (January 2021, revised May 2025):
  - Section 5.1: differential -40 to 40 V.
  - Section 5.5: CMRR 140 dB min; Vos +/-5 uV max; gain error +/-0.1 % max.
  - Table 6-3: 3Fh DEVICE_ID, reset 2381h.
- Research.md at e13f5f60: V179, V177 and V166 answered "for research (owner, 2026-09-28)"; F15 is 16 cells, 67.2 V (owner, 2026-09-25); the Scope table puts connector overvoltage protection in round 2.
- IOBoard.md:355: the only 0.15 A figure, the servo bind step.
- Arithmetic:
  - INA237: 1e-6 V/V x 62.2 V = 62.2 uV; 62.2 uV / 100 uOhm = 0.622 A.
  - INA238: 0.1e-6 V/V x 62.2 V = 6.2 uV = 0.062 A.
  - 67.2 V - 40 V = 27.2 V over the rating.
- Downloaded copies: /home/claude/rcbench-research/round1/scratch/T3/adjudicator-R8/ext-ina237/ina237.pdf and /home/claude/rcbench-research/round1/scratch/T3/adjudicator-R8/ext-ina237/ina238.pdf.
